CHK.DJANGO.DEBUG_OFF.title: Django DEBUG is off
CHK.DJANGO.DEBUG_OFF.remediation: Set DEBUG = False in every deployed environment (read it from the environment, default False).

CHK.DJANGO.ALLOWED_HOSTS.title: Django ALLOWED_HOSTS is an explicit allow-list
CHK.DJANGO.ALLOWED_HOSTS.remediation: List your real host names in ALLOWED_HOSTS; never use '*'.

CHK.DJANGO.SIGNING_KEY_STRENGTH.title: Django SECRET_KEY is strong
CHK.DJANGO.SIGNING_KEY_STRENGTH.remediation: Generate a random SECRET_KEY of at least 50 characters (e.g. django.core.management.utils.get_random_secret_key), keep it out of source control, and load it from the environment.

CHK.DJANGO.SIGNING_KEY_FALLBACKS.title: Old Django signing keys are strong and few
CHK.DJANGO.SIGNING_KEY_FALLBACKS.remediation: Keep at most two SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS during a rotation, make each one strong, and remove them once sessions have rolled over.

CHK.DJANGO.DB_CREDENTIALS_SET.title: Network databases require credentials
CHK.DJANGO.DB_CREDENTIALS_SET.remediation: Give every network database connection a user and a strong credential loaded from the environment.

CHK.DJANGO.SECURITY_MIDDLEWARE.title: Django SecurityMiddleware is enabled
CHK.DJANGO.SECURITY_MIDDLEWARE.remediation: Add django.middleware.security.SecurityMiddleware near the top of MIDDLEWARE.

CHK.DJANGO.CLICKJACKING.title: Pages can't be framed by other sites

CHK.DJANGO.SSL_REDIRECT.title: HTTP is redirected to HTTPS
CHK.DJANGO.SSL_REDIRECT.remediation: Set SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT = True (and SECURE_PROXY_SSL_HEADER if you run behind a TLS-terminating proxy).

CHK.DJANGO.HSTS.title: HSTS is set for at least a year
CHK.DJANGO.HSTS.remediation: Set SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS = 31536000 once HTTPS works everywhere; add includeSubDomains only when every subdomain serves HTTPS.

CHK.DJANGO.SESSION_COOKIE_FLAGS.title: Session cookies are Secure and HttpOnly
CHK.DJANGO.SESSION_COOKIE_FLAGS.remediation: Set SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE = True and SESSION_COOKIE_HTTPONLY = True.

CHK.DJANGO.COOP.title: A cross-origin opener policy is set

CHK.DJANGO.CORS_NOT_WILDCARD.title: CORS isn't open to every origin
CHK.DJANGO.CORS_NOT_WILDCARD.remediation: List exact origins in CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS; don't combine CORS_ALLOW_ALL_ORIGINS or a catch-all regex with credentials.

CHK.DJANGO.ADMIN_URL.title: The Django admin isn't at /admin/
CHK.DJANGO.ADMIN_URL.remediation: Mount the admin at a less guessable path (this only reduces noise; the admin still needs strong sign-in).

CHK.DJANGO.DRF_DEFAULT_DENY.title: Django REST framework denies by default
CHK.DJANGO.DRF_DEFAULT_DENY.remediation: Set REST_FRAMEWORK['DEFAULT_PERMISSION_CLASSES'] to IsAuthenticated (or stricter) and open endpoints one by one.

CHK.DJANGO.PASSWORD_POLICY.title: Password rules are strong
CHK.DJANGO.PASSWORD_POLICY.remediation: Enable Django's password validators with MinimumLengthValidator min_length >= 12 and CommonPasswordValidator.

CHK.DJANGO.DB_TLS.title: Database connections use TLS
CHK.DJANGO.DB_TLS.remediation: Set OPTIONS sslmode to 'require' (or verify-full) for every network PostgreSQL database.

CHK.DJANGO.EMAIL_TLS.title: Outgoing email uses TLS
CHK.DJANGO.EMAIL_TLS.remediation: With the SMTP backend, set EMAIL_USE_TLS = True (port 587) or EMAIL_USE_SSL = True (port 465).
